responsibility: This header declares the public interface to the mc-boot runtime's basic varargs facility. It introduces the opaque varargs_vararg handle and exports the fixed-arity constructors for wrapping one to four arguments, along with operations to count wrapped arguments, fetch or replace the next argument with exact-size checking, reset the current argument index, duplicate a vararg bundle, and destroy it.
same_name_distinction: Declares the opaque varargs handle and public fixed-arity constructor/accessor API for the varargs facility, while Gvarargs.cc contains the concrete record layout and storage-copying implementation.
